4110.title: Abandoned drawer gestures retain partial translation
4110.rootCauseOneLine: Drag intent sets openMobile before completion; fresh starts reject that state and selection cancellation does not reset it. End handlers also omit final coordinate sampling.

prReviews.topFinding: Addresses verified mechanisms; PR code not executed.

4110.proposedFix: Reset stale drag state before a new gesture and on selection, and sample matching release coordinates.
4110.caveats: Synthetic events; no physical-device event-loss reproduction. Component harness only.
